supressIntermediateErrors does not work for contract failure
`supressIntermediateErrors` in `retry` works well for all kinds of errors except contract failure.
I guess behavior should be the same for all kinds of errors, otherwise it's counterintuitive.

We can see, that request marked as failed after every retry
